categories.name: Non-Critical Admission
categories.description: Patient is admitted to a non-critical inpatient ward (Admission NC), advancing the patient toward a documented disposition while engaging standard ward resources.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=15 (Admission NC). The narrative sample shows this alternative occurring frequently as a standard ward placement (e.g. in V0008, V0625, V0605), without requiring subdivision or combination.

categories.name: Intensive Care Admission
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an intensive care inpatient ward (Admission IC). This alternative incurs a negative contribution (-25) to the softgoal 'Minimize time-to-treatment' due to intensive placement overhead, and contributes to overall patient disposition under goal id=5.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=16 (Admission IC). The narrative sample evidences its realization in more complex, high-duration or intensive pathways (such as V0605, V0317, V0068, V0710) where intensive care management is triggered.
